answer: The falcon assignment is published and ferrous records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an attacker cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the ridge graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 3720 identities would post 3282 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
